entry.reason: Dedicated framing-template core-probe scene generator gen_scenes.py: reads oracle/oracle-golden.json and writes the committed probe scenes/*.scene and index.json, auditing each scene against its probe-member rectangles; imports only the standard library and its sibling scene_reader, and the scenes reach the native core only through run_probe.sh in WSL; probe tooling, not a product-loaded module or current product entry point.
